notes: Governing documents for faculty leave are present (the no-policy coding (`missing`) not triggered): CAM HR-43 (modified teaching duties, scope tenure-track faculty), HR-52 (parental leave for academic staff), HR-33 (FMLA), HR-81 (sick leave for academic staff) and Provost's Communication 16 (tenure-clock rollbacks). 2018_00_link is the University of Illinois System HR summary of HR-52; it supplies only the pay level ('regular rate of pay') and timing detail. Tenured/tenure-track faculty were not in a bargaining unit (version note).

Birth parent chain: parental leave 2 weeks paid (c1), with FMLA 12 workweeks running from the start (c3 concurrent_with c1; 10 unpaid weeks remain, accrued sick c4 or vacation c7 may be substituted) -> discretionary unpaid extension beyond FMLA, no length (c8 consecutive_after c3); modified teaching duties up to one semester (c2) also_available with c1, so placed after it (2 + 1 semester); sick-leave pay for pregnancy/own illness: own balance (c4), 13 extended days (c5, within the discretionary half-year c6, 3 years' service required); SURS disability (c11) after sick leave runs out, no length; tenure rollback one year (c12).

Non-birth parent chain: parental leave 2 weeks paid (c1), FMLA alongside from the start (c3 concurrent_with c1) -> discretionary extension (c8); modified teaching duties one semester (c2) also_available with c1; sick leave usable up to twelve weeks to care for the child, from own balance (c4); tenure rollback one year (c12).

Calendar: semester system inferred from HR-43's 'one semester' and 'successive semesters' (kind of term stated, no length) -> calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order. HR-52's 'academic appointment year (i.e., August 21-August 20)' is not a term length.

Documents cited but not saved: CAM 'Leaves of Absence Without Pay'; CAM 'Shared Benefits (Sick Leave) for Academic Staff'; University vacation leave provisions and 'Policy and Rules-Nonacademic'; State Universities Retirement System disability benefit terms; University policies on 'Disability Leave' (HR-33 return from Disability Leave); Provost's Communication #15 (Effect of Leave Without Pay on the Probationary Period); Provost's Communication No. 9 (letters to external evaluators; not a benefit); University Statutes Article X; FMLA application/certification forms; System pages 'Parental Leave for Same-Sex Domestic Partners', 'Nursing Mothers in the Workplace', 'Policy and Rules for Civil Service Staff' and the NESSIE Domestic Partner page; CAM 'Parental Leave for Graduate Assistants' (other group). CAM navigation titles also list 'Bereavement Leave', 'Flexible Work Schedules', 'Probationary Period', 'Jury Duty and Military Leave', 'Transfer of Sick Leave and Vacation Credit' (not parental or not saved).

HR-33 notes that a leave of absence to care for a parent-in-law may be granted under sick-leave and other leave policies; not a parental provision, not a component. HR-33 also allows a temporary transfer to an alternative position for intermittent medical leave; a scheduling device for intermittent leave, not a pregnancy accommodation, not a component.
Domestic partners: the System summary says many benefits extend to registered same-sex domestic partners; the policies themselves do not reference them.
Provost's Communication 16 is version_uncertain (only capture 2018-05-11, after the reference date; per the document's version note); both tenure-clock components carry the flag.
